symptoms: Secondary infection in scabies and eczema

management_steps.details: Children <= 7 years of age: 12-25 mg/kg/dose 6 hourly for 5 days. Children > 7 years of age and adults: 500 mg 6 hourly for 5 days. Acute paronychia (adults): 500 mg 6 hourly for 5 days.
First-line option for Staphylococcal skin infections.
